war_summary: War 139 is on day 116 with no winner and remains concentrated on several active, contested fronts. Endless Shore is currently the most volatile region, recording 48 strategic-base events in 24 hours, four in the last two hours, accelerating recent casualties, and a 7–3 Colonial ownership advantage. Oarbreaker has similarly high churn with 46 events and six in the last two hours, despite all nine bases currently being Warden-held. Clahstra, Godcrofts, Onyx, and Callahan’s Passage also show substantial combat and recent ownership movement: Clahstra has 13 events with a 6–2 Warden lead, Godcrofts has 31 events and an even four–four split plus one neutral base, Onyx has 13 events with three Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base, while Callahan’s Passage has six events amid the war’s heaviest casualty totals and a six–four Warden–Colonial split. Several other regions show little or no recent base activity and appear comparatively stable.
